help.faq.cycle-record-period.question: Ndenge nini nakoki kokoma sanza na ngai?
help.faq.cycle-record-period.subtitle: Zwá dati mpe ntango oyo okómi na eleko yango.
help.faq.cycle-record-period.answer: Na kalandriye to na zulunalo Daily, tyá dati ya ebandeli ya eleko na yo, ntango oyo eleko yango eumeli, mpe ndenge oyo okómi na yango.AWA. . .
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.question: Nakoki kobongisa dati ya sanza?
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.subtitle: Soki obongoli ndenge ozali kolanda bato, tosá dati.
help.faq.cycle-edit-period.answer: Ɛɛ. Salá ete dati oyo ezali na esika oyo ozali kokoma makambo oyo okosala na nsima ezala ndenge moko na oyo ozali kosala na bomoi na yo.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.question: Ndenge nini nakoki kotánga sanza na ngai ya mikolo oyo?
help.faq.cycle-predictions.subtitle: Ba estimations oyo euti na lisolo na yo moko.
help.faq.cycle-predictions.answer: AWA etángaka eleko na yo ya nsima, fenetre ya kobota mpe ovulation na kotalela makambo oyo okutaná na yango, ntango oyo okotambola na yango, mpe makambo oyo okomi kokoma.
help.faq.cycle-flow.question: Ndenge nini nakoki koyeba ndenge oyo nazali kobenda mai?
help.faq.cycle-flow.subtitle: Tyá na lokasa ndenge makila na yo ezali kobongwana.
help.faq.cycle-flow.answer: Salelá zulunalo Daily mpo na koyeba soki sanza na yo ezali kotambola ndenge nini, mpe na ndenge yango, okomona ndenge oyo yango ebongwanaka na boumeli ya mikemike.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.question: Balembo ya kalandriye yango elimboli nini?
help.faq.cycle-calendar.subtitle: Ntango ya kobotama, kobota, kokata mbuma mpe kalandriye ya Hijri.
help.faq.cycle-calendar.answer: Soki batye elembo ya elimo, okoki mpe kolakisa dati ya Hijri esika moko na dati ya Grégorien.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.questio: Ndenge nini nakoki koyeba ete nazali na libándá ya ndako?
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.subtitl: Talá mikolo oyo bato balobaka ete ezali malamu mingi.
help.faq.conceive-fertile-window.answer: Na mode ya koluka kobota, AWA elakisi fenetre ya kobota oyo eyebani na kolanda makambo oyo okutanaki na yango na bomoi mpe makambo oyo okutanaki na yango.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.question: Ndenge nini bokanisi ete nabotaka na kati ya makila?
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.subtitle: Soki ozali kolanda, okomona ete ezali na makambo mosusu oyo ezali kosalema.
help.faq.conceive-ovulation.answer: Soki ozali kobakisa makambo ya sika, bokoki kobongola ndenge oyo ozali kotánga yango.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.question: Nakoki koyeba soki nazali na mɔtɔ ya makasi?
help.faq.conceive-temperature.subtitle: Na nsima, moná ndenge oyo okómi na nzoto.
help.faq.conceive-temperature.answer: Ɛɛ, kolanda molunge ya baseli ezali moko ya makambo oyo esalemaka na ntango ya kobota.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.questio: Nakoki koyeba ndenge oyo nazali komɛla nkingo ya libele?
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.subtitl: Na nsima, tyá elembo oyo na molɔngɔ ya makambo oyo okosala mpo na koyeba soki mwana azali kobota.
help.faq.conceive-cervical-mucus.answer: Ɛɛ, kolanda mwa nsinga ya ligboma ya ligboma ezali moko ya makambo oyo ezali na "Mopɛto ya koluka kobota".
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.question: Nakoki kokoma na test ya ovulation ya LH?
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.subtitle: Tyá makambo oyo ozali komona na nsima.
help.faq.conceive-lh-test.answer: Ɛɛ, kosala baekzamɛ ya ovulation ya LH ezali na kati ya bokeseni ya kobota.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.question: Ndenge nini nakoki kokoma makambo oyo etali kosangisa nzoto?
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.subtitle: Ezali likambo moko ya ntina mingi na buku na yo ya makambo ya bomoi.
help.faq.conceive-intercourse.answer: Na eteni ya boyokani ya kati, okoki kokoma makambo ya kosangisa nzoto mpe makambo mosusu oyo etali yango.
help.faq.contraception-method.question: Ndenge nini nakoki koyeba mayele ya kopekisa kobota?
help.faq.contraception-method.subtitle: Nkisi, lopɛtɛ, nkisi ya kotya na nzoto mpe nkisi ya monganga.
help.faq.contraception-method.answer: AWA ezali kosalisa mpo na koyeba soki nkisi ya kopekisa kobota, elamba ya mwasi ya kobota, nkisi ya kopekisa kobota mpe bankisi mosusu ya hormone.
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.que: Nakoki kotya mwa eloko mpo na kokundwela ye mpo na mwa nkisi oyo napesaki ye?
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.sub: Bongisá makambo oyo okoki kokundwela moto.
help.faq.contraception-pill-reminder.ans: Ɛɛ. AWA ezali na makambo oyo ekoki kosalisa yo oyeba ndenge ya komɛla yango, mpe ezali na makambo oyo osengeli koyeba mokolo na mokolo.
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.qu: Nakoki kokoma mwa bapɔpɔ oyo nabungisaki?
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.su: Landá ndenge oyo bakɔtisi yango te.
help.faq.contraception-forgotten-pill.an: Ɛɛ, kolanda milinga oyo bazangi ezali moko ya makambo oyo esɛngaka kosala mpo na kopekisa kobota.
help.faq.contraception-history.question: Nakoki kozwa nini na lisoló na ngai ya bato oyo bazalaki kozwa yango?
help.faq.contraception-history.subtitle: Talelá doze oyo otángaki mpe bapilɛrɛ oyo ozangaki.
help.faq.contraception-history.answer: Bokoki kozwa lisoló ya bokɔnɔ na yo mpo na kokoma ndenge oyo obandaki kosalela mayele ya kopekisa kobota.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.quest: Ntango ozali kozwa nkisi ya kopekisa kobota, ezali na ntina mpo na yo?
help.faq.contraception-predictions.subti: Mayele mosusu ekoki kobongola bomoi na yo.
help.faq.contraception-predictions.answe: AWA ekoki kokoba kolakisa makambo oyo ezali na esika na yango, kasi ndenge oyo ozali kolimbola makambo oyo ozali koloba etali makambo oyo ozali kokutana na yango mpe ndenge oyo ozali kosalela yango.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.question: Soki moto azali na eleko moko ya molai, ebongi mpenza koloba ete azali "koumela"?
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.subtitle: AWA ezali na ba cycles ya kozanga bosembo.
help.faq.irregular-long-cycle.answer: Te. Na mode SOPK/Réglement cycles, AWA esalaka te ete cycle molai ezala "na nsima".
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.question: Nini ezali bilembo oyo nakoki koyeba soki nazali na maladi ya PCOS?
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.subtitle: Talá ndenge bilembo yango ebongwanaka na boumeli ya ntango.
help.faq.irregular-symptoms.answer: Kokokisama ya makambo yango esangisi mitángo ya mikemike, makama ya ntolo, kokóla ya nsuki, kobongwana ya kilo mpe bilembo oyo eyokani na yango.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.question: Nakoki koyeba soki nsuki na ngai ezali kobota to ezali kobota?
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.subtitle: Zwá makambo oyo okutaná na yango na programɛ na yo ya kolanda maladi ya PCOS.
help.faq.irregular-acne-hair.answer: Ɛɛ, bolumbu ya motó mpe ntolo ezali na kati ya makambo oyo bato oyo babandá na maladi yango basalaka.
help.faq.irregular-weight.question: Nakoki koyeba soki nazali na bozito ya ndenge nini?
help.faq.irregular-weight.subtitle: Talá ndenge oyo kilo na yo ebongwanaka na boumeli ya ntango.
help.faq.irregular-weight.answer: Ɛɛ, bokoki kolanda kilo na PCOS/Mikakatano ya nzoto.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.question: Mpo na nini makanisi na ngai ekeseni?
help.faq.irregular-predictions.subtitle: Ntango bato bazali kosala makambo ndenge na ndenge te, yango esalaka ete bato báyeba ete makambo oyo bazali kosala ezali mpenza te.
help.faq.irregular-predictions.answer: Ntango mikemike ezali ya kozanga bosembo, soki bato bazali na likoki ya koyeba yango, bakoki kobongwana mingi.AWAasalelaka makambo oyo okutaná na yango kozanga ete ata moto moko te akóma nsima ya ngonga.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.question: Makambo nini nakoki koyeba?
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.subtitle: Kolanda makambo oyo ebongisami mpo na kotalela mbongwana oyo ezali kosalema na bomoi na biso.
help.faq.menopause-symptoms.answer: Mpo na koyeba makambo yango, tokoki kotánga kobotama ya mɔtɔ, kotoka mpɛmbɛ na butu, kolala malamu, kolɛmba, kobongwana ya makanisi mpe mwa molili ya bɔɔngɔ.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.question: Nakoki kokoma makambo oyo ezali kobima na ntango ya molunge?
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.subtitle: Talá ndenge oyo ezalaka na ntango oyo ezali koleka.
help.faq.menopause-hot-flashes.answer: Ɛɛ, kolɛnga ya mɔtɔ ezali moko ya bilembo oyo ezali komonana na eleko ya Perimenopause to ya Menopause.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.question: Nakoki koyeba ndenge nalalaka mpe ndenge nalɛmbaka?
help.faq.menopause-sleep.subtitle: Talá ndenge ozali kolala mpe ndenge ozali kolɛmba.
help.faq.menopause-sleep.answer: Ya solo, mikakatano ya mpɔngi, kotoka na butu mpe kolɛmba ezali na ntina mingi na mobembo yango.
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.qu: Nakoki koyeba ndenge oyo nzoto na ngai esalaka na boyokani na hormone?
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.su: Kobá koyeba makambo oyo ekosalisa yo oyeba soki ozali na bomoi.
help.faq.menopause-hormonal-treatment.an: Ɛɛ, okoki kolanda ndenge oyo bato basalaka na makambo ya hormone.
help.faq.menopause-labs.question: Nakoki kokoma makambo oyo esalemaki na FSH mpe estradiol?
help.faq.menopause-labs.subtitle: Na nsima, longolá makambo mosusu oyo euti na laboratɛrɛ.
help.faq.menopause-labs.answer: Ɛɛ, tokoki kokoma makambo oyo esalemaki na laboratɛrɛ, na ndakisa FSH mpe estradiol.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.question: Ndenge nini mokolo oyo nakokóma mobange esɛngaka?
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.subtitle: Ndimbola oyo emonisami na baekzamɛ ya bokɔnɔ na yo.
help.faq.pregnancy-due-date.answer: Koyeba soki ozali na zemi ezali kosala ete mokolo oyo okokisi naino te kobota esuka na makambo oyo ozali na yango.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.question: Nakoki koyeba soki nazali na zemi pɔsɔ na pɔsɔ?
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.subtitle: Talá ndenge zemi na yo ezali kokende pɔsɔ na pɔsɔ.
help.faq.pregnancy-weekly.answer: Ɛɛ, AWA ezali kopesa yo baekzamɛ ya pɔsɔ na pɔsɔ mpe emonisi ndenge zemi na yo ezali kokende.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.question: Nakoki kokoma makambo oyo nakosala na lopitalo?
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.subtitle: Tyá makambo ya ntina na esika moko.
help.faq.pregnancy-appointments.answer: Ɛɛ, kokende na lopitalo mpe kosala bakzamɛ ya ntina mingi ezali na kati ya koyeba soki zemi ezali nini.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.question: Nakoki kozwa makambo oyo nakokanisa mpo na bakzamɛ na ngai?
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.subtitle: Tyá makambo oyo okoyebisa yo.
help.faq.pregnancy-reminders.answer: Ɛɛ, ezali na makambo oyo ekundwelaka yo ntango okosala makita mpe ntango okozwa bakzamɛ ya ntina mingi.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.question: Nakoki koyeba nini na ntango ya zemi?
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.subtitle: Bilembo, kilo, elimo, mpɔngi mpe makambo mosusu.
help.faq.pregnancy-journal.answer: Kokundola zemi ekoki kozala na makambo lokola kilo, makanisi, mpɔngi mpe makambo ya monganga.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.question: Ndenge nini nakoki koyeba soki nazali na maladi ya lochia?
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.subtitle: Talá ntango oyo eumeli mpe ndenge oyo ebandi kobima.
help.faq.postpartum-lochia.answer: Mpo na koyeba soki mwana abotami, esengeli koyeba ntango nini maladi yango eumeli, ndenge oyo maladi yango ebandá, mpe ndenge oyo bilembo yango ezali komonana.
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.questio: Ndenge nini nakoki koyeba soki sanza na ngai ezali kozonga?
help.faq.postpartum-cycle-return.answer: AWA etambolaka na nsima ya kozonga ya sanza na yo, kozonga ya eleko na yo mpe mbongwana ya ba hormones nsima ya kobota.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.questi: Nakoki koyeba soki mwana azali komɛlisa mabɛlɛ mpe soki azali komɛla mabɛlɛ?
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.subtit: Kobomba makambo yango na mobembo na yo nsima ya kobota.
help.faq.postpartum-breastfeeding.answer: Ɛɛ, mpo na koyeba soki maladi yango ezali ndenge nini, esengeli komɛlisa mama mabɛlɛ mpe komɛlisa ye mpasi nsima ya kobota.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.question: Nakoki koyeba nini na ntango ya kozonga na nzoto?
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.subtitle: Mpasi, mpɔngi, nkanda, mpasi mpe nzoto ezali kozonga malamu.
help.faq.postpartum-recovery.answer: Nsima ya kobota, bato oyo bazali komona nzoto mokolo na mokolo balɛmbi, balali mpɔngi, bazali na makanisi mabe, bazali koyoka mpasi mpe bazali kozonga nzoto malamu.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.question: Ndenge nini AWA esalaka na nifas?
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.subtitle: Ezali elembo ya losambo, oyo ekeseni na oyo ya monganga.
help.faq.postpartum-nifas.answer: Soki batye elembo ya elimo, AWA ekoki kolanda ntango oyo makila ebimaka nsima ya kobota mpe komonisa esika oyo nifas ezali kotalela makambo oyo bato baponi.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.question: Ndenge nini nakoki koyeba soki nazali kotanga makila?
help.faq.loss-bleeding.subtitle: Talá ndenge ezali kokola, kozanga kozonga nokinoki na nzela oyo bato bazalaki kolanda.
help.faq.loss-bleeding.answer: Na nsima, lisolo "Na nsima ya kolongola zemi" emonisi ndenge makila ebimaka mpe ndenge esalemaka na esika oyo ebongisami mpo na eleko yango.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.question: Ndenge nini nakoki koyeba ndenge oyo motángo na ngai ya mitángo ezali kozonga?
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.subtitle: Kobá kolanda na ndenge oyo ozali kosala.
help.faq.loss-cycle-return.answer: AWA etambolaka na nsima ya kolongola zemi, mpe esalisaka yo ozongela makambo oyo elekaki na nsima kozanga ete obimisa yango mbala moko.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.question: Makambo nini nakoki koyeba?
help.faq.loss-symptoms.subtitle: Landá bilembo oyo olingi koyeba.
help.faq.loss-symptoms.answer: Na mobembo yango, okoki koyeba ndenge oyo nzoto na yo ezali komiyoka.
help.faq.loss-notes.question: Nakoki kokoma makambo oyo etali ngai moko?
help.faq.loss-notes.subtitle: Ezali na esika moko na kati ya journal na yo.
help.faq.loss-notes.answer: Ɛɛ, ezali na mikanda oyo ekoki kosalisa yo na boumeli ya ntango yango.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.question: Nakoki kozonga na mosala ya kobota nsima?
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.subtitle: Kobongola mokano na yo ntango nyonso oyo olingi komeka lisusu.
help.faq.loss-conceive-again.answer: Esalisaka yo obanda lisusu kosala milende mpo na kozwa zemi, kasi kobongwana ya mokano na yo ezalaka mokemoke mpe ezalaka ntango nyonso ekateli na yo moko.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.question: Ndenge nini kalandriye ya Hijri esalaka?
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.subtitle: Emonisi dati ya Hijri esika moko na dati ya Grégorien.
help.faq.spiritual-hijri.answer: Soki batye ba marqueurs ya elimo na nzela, AWA ekoki kolakisa dati ya Hijri na nzela ya dati ya Grégorien mpe kolakisa sanza ya ntina lokola Ramadan to Dhul Hijjah.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.question: Kozala pɛto elimboli nini?
help.faq.spiritual-purity.subtitle: Likambo moko ya mayele oyo etali kozongela losambo.
help.faq.spiritual-purity.answer: AWA ekoki kolakisa elembo moko oyo ekesenisaka eleko na yo na eleko ya bopɛto na yo ntango batyá elembo ya elimo.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.questio: Ndenge nini AWA emonisi ntango oyo libondeli esengeli kozongisama?
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.subtitl: Ezali elembo oyo emonisi ntango oyo okómi na eleko ya komɛla.
help.faq.spiritual-prayer-return.answer: Soki obongoli motema liboso ete ntango ya kobondela esila, app yango ekoki kolakisa ete libondeli yango esengeli kozonga lisusu.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.question: Ndenge nini kolanda bileko ya kolala mpo na kobongisa mosala esalaka?
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.subtitle: Ntango oyo okɔtaka na eleko na yo ezali mingi.
help.faq.spiritual-qadaa.answer: AWA ekoki kopesa yo mbongo mpo na mikolo ya koboya kolia mpo na eleko na yo, mingimingi na eleko ya Ramadan, elongo na likambo ya kokundwela yo nsima ya sanza mpo na kobongisa ndenge ya kozongisa yango.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.question: Ndenge nini nifas emonisami?
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.subtitle: Ezali elembo oyo ekoki kokesana na makanisi ya bato.
help.faq.spiritual-nifas.answer: AWA ekoki kolakisa référence ya lingomba oyo baponi mpo na boumeli ya mikolo oyo nifas ekoumela, na kotyáká likebi na bokeseni kati na biteyelo oyo makambo oyo endimami ezali kolobela yango.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.question: AWA apesi toli na likambo etali isthada?
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.subtitle: Ezali na makambo ya koteya, kasi ezali te na makambo ya moto na moto.
help.faq.spiritual-istihada.answer: AWA ekoki kopesa mateya ya mateya ya ntina na isthâda mpe oyo yango elimboli mpo na momeseno.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.question: Nakoki kokoma nini na journal na ngai?
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Bilembo, elimo, boyokani ya malamu, mpɔngi mpe misala.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answer: Zulunalo Daily elobeli bilembo ya nzoto, ndenge oyo moto azali komiyoka, boyokani ya malamu, mpɔngi, mosala ya makasi mpe makambo oyo moto akomi.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.subtitle: Bilembo, makanisi, mpɔngi, kosala mosala, komɛla mai, kobima na eleko ya kobota mpe makambo oyo ezali kobima.
help.faq.journal-what-can-track.answerDa: Zulunalo Daily esalisaka yo oyeba makambo oyo ezali komonana na nzoto, ndenge ozali komiyoka, ndenge ozali kolala, ndenge ozali kosala mosala, ndenge oyo omipesi na mai, ndenge oyo okendeke na eleko ya komata mpe makambo oyo okosala na bomoi na yo.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.question: Bokoki kobatela eteni ya boyokani na ngai na kati ya libota?
help.faq.journal-intimacy.subtitle: Ezali na eteni moko ya mayele, oyo ezali na esika moko te.
help.faq.journal-intimacy.answer: Ɛɛ, eteni ya boyokani ya penepene ekoki kobombama mpe kobatelama na PIN to Face ID na yango moko.
